text:
rachel: Heads-up — starting onboarding for stellaris-4b-int8. Scope: hosted + dedicated + private. Need intake, prioritization, and a tight rollout checklist. Target SLOs: p95 < 200ms (short seq), p99 < 350ms. Who can own smoke + quant regressions?

sam: I can drive the quant experiments. Offline numbers look promising — int8 gives ~2x token throughput on our A100 tests. Quality-wise: small BLEU drop on codebench (~1.8%) but chatbench metrics within noise. We'll want a formal quality gate though.

liam: From an ops perspective, recommend fallback chain: hosted -> dedicated -> luma-3b-q4 (fallback-1). For private deployments, require explicit pin and offline bundle. Also add route-level model variant config so clients can opt into fallback.

rachel: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Perf & cost matrix + checklist 2) Run quantization smoke + eval set 3) Canary hosted 1% -> 5% -> 20% (monitor for 30m per step) 4) Bring up dedicated warm pool in parallel 5) Offer private image after compliance checks. Target window: Thu 02:00-06:00 PT.

eva: Add eval gates: no more than 2% degradation on primary metrics (chatbench accuracy / helpfulness) and no more than 1% safety regression measured by our safety suite. Also include focused prompts for hallucination and instruction-following edge cases.

sam: I have a quant notebook and initial script. Example snippet: ```python
run_quant_eval(model='stellaris-4b', dtype='int8', eval_set='chatbench', top_k=5)
``` Early numbers: latency x2 speedup on a100-40GB; GPU memory usage down ~60%. Will upload full report.

liam: Ops checklist items: - pre-warm KV cache: run loadgen at 10qps for 15m before cutting traffic - ensure dedicated autoscale floor includes reserved capacity - configure traffic-split policy with rollback triggers: error_rate > 3% or p95 > 2x baseline - set concurrency limits per route to avoid tail latency cascade.

rachel: Observability: tag traces with model=stellaris-4b, quant=int8, rollout=canary-v1. Wire eval alerts into Redwood Optimize so quality regressions create incidents. Add a dedicated per-route dashboard (latency, cost, token breakdown).

infra-bot: deploy job created: deploy/stellaris-int8-canary by rachel — status: queued.

sam: Smoke commands to run during canary: 
```bash
redwood-cli traffic set --model stellaris-4b:int8 --weight 1% --route hosted-canary
redwood-cli eval run --suite chatbench --thresholds canary_thresholds.yml
```
Also will run localized prompt sets for safety.

eva: Need ownership for rollback playbook and support runbook entry. Support needs a short FAQ for private customers explaining pinning and KMS usage.

liam: I'll own rollback. Rollback steps (short): 1) shift traffic off stellaris to fallback model 2) scale up dedicated fallback pool 3) invalidate prefix/KV caches 4) tag incident, post customer notifications if any SLA risk 5) revert canary config. I'll add exact CLI steps to the playbook.

rachel: Final items before Thursday: compliance signoff for private image, KMS keys validated, e2e tests green, and a runbook in eng-oncall + support FAQs. If all green we start canary on schedule.

sam: Will post full quant report and evaluation dashboards tomorrow morning and attach links here.

rachel: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
